title: Malaysian Magical Toast
description: A fusion of magical and malaysian flavors on a crispy bread base.
instructions: 2. Toast the magical bread slices until crispy.
3. In a separate pan, toast the cubed crusty bread until lightly browned.
4. In a small bowl, mix together the malaysian spice blend and toasted coconut flakes.
5. Spread the dairy-free butter or margarine evenly onto the toasted magical bread slices.
6. Sprinkle the malaysian spice blend mixture evenly onto the magical bread slices.
7. Top with the toasted cubed crusty bread.
9. For an extra crispy top, place under the broiler for 1-2 minutes.
10. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
